CmdhBackOffParametersSet.label: CmdhBackOffParametersSet
CmdhBackOffParametersSet.description: This Object defines set of parameters which can be referenced by a specific Instance of the CmdhNwAccessRule Object (ID: 2055)

NetworkAction.label: NetworkAction
NetworkAction.description: Contains specific action actually  attempted on the network (e.g. cellular-registration)

InitialBackoffTime.label: InitialBackoffTime
InitialBackoffTime.description: Regarding the BackOffParameters of a certain CmdhNwAccessRule  Object Instance, this Resource contains the value for the Initial wait time.

AdditionalBackoffTime.label: AdditionalBackoffTime
AdditionalBackoffTime.description: Regarding the BackOffParameters of a certain CmdhNwAccessRule  Object Instance, this Resource contains the value for an additional wait tme.

MaximumBackoffTime.label: MaximumBackoffTime
MaximumBackoffTime.description: Regarding the BackOffParameters of a certain CmdhNwAccessRule  Object Instance, this Resource contains the value for the maximum wait time

OptionalRandomBackoffTime.label: OptionalRandomBackoffTime
OptionalRandomBackoffTime.description: Regarding the BackOffParameters of a certain CmdhNwAccessRule  Object Instance, this Resource contains the value for an optional random wait time.
